meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析RNA-seq数据来发现基因间的调控连接
copy.tagline_en: Infer transcription factor-target gene relationships from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover regulatory interactions from RNA-seq data

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能根据基因表达数据推断基因调控网络,识别哪些转录因子调控哪些靶基因,并输出带重要度评分的调控关系表。
howto.when: 当你说“分析转录组数据”、“识别转录因子与靶基因关系”等,或提供 RNA-seq 表达数据时触发。

say.text: 用 GRNBoost2 推断这个表达矩阵的基因调控网络。
say.note: 会返回 TF、靶基因和重要度表格。

say.text: 分析这份单细胞 RNA-seq 数据,找出转录因子调控关系。
say.note: 支持单细胞数据,可指定种子保证可复现。

say.text: 用 GENIE3 对比一下两种算法的结果。
say.note: 适合做算法比较或验证。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data, identifying which transcription factors regulate which target genes, and output a table of regulatory links with importance scores. It supports distributed computing for large datasets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze transcriptomics data, identify transcription factor–target gene relationships, or provide RNA-seq expression data. It also applies to large-scale parallel computing tasks.

say_en.text: Use GRNBoost2 to infer the gene regulatory network from this expression matrix.
Analyze this single-cell RNA-seq data to find transcription factor regulatory relationships.
say_en.note: Handles single-cell data with seed support.

say_en.text: Use GENIE3 to compare results from the two algorithms.
